{"people":[{"name":"Renee","role":"rep (account executive, us)","side":"us"},{"name":"Owen","role":"VP of Product","side":"customer"},{"name":"Diane","role":"CFO","side":"customer"},{"name":"Unnamed engineering lead","role":"engineering lead","side":"customer"},{"name":"PMM","role":"interviewer","side":"other"}],
"competitors":[],
"incumbent":"Homegrown billing system, built by a former employee",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"The billing system is homegrown, built by a guy who left","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Incumbent description, secondhand from Owen, not quoted."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"He reached out to us.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Customer initiated contact; the trigger was not a specific event."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"every pricing change takes them a quarter.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Pain point relayed secondhand; unquoted."},
{"id":"E4","turn":4,"excerpt":"He wanted it done before they launched a new pricing tier","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Pricing tier had no date, so no hard deadline."},
{"id":"E5","turn":6,"excerpt":"The CFO, I guess?","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep guesses Diane is the decider; hedged."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"She froze it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Freeze is the reported decision event."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"They missed their number in Q3 and she put a hold on all new vendor projects.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Freeze covered all vendor projects, not just this one."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"So I don't know that you'd say she decided against us.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep argues the freeze was not a decision against us."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"She decided against everything.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Conflicts with rep's earlier claim it was not against us."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"I never spoke to her.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep had no direct contact with the likely decider."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"Owen said he'd bring her in at the end.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Diane was in no meeting; she was planned for the end."},
{"id":"E12","turn":12,"excerpt":"It was us against doing nothing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep reads the deal as no competitor, only status quo."},
{"id":"E13","turn":12,"excerpt":"Owen never looked at anybody else, as far as I know.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Hedged; rep may not know the full competitive picture."},
{"id":"E14","turn":14,"excerpt":"do you have something that shows payback?","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","gaps"],"note":"Finance-driven request for payback; a new question late in cycle."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"That started maybe a month before the freeze.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Hedged timing of the payback request."},
{"id":"E16","turn":16,"excerpt":"Changing a price in a few clicks, trials, proration.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Billing demo content that drew a reaction."},
{"id":"E17","turn":16,"excerpt":"that's a quarter of roadmap in five minutes.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Strong reaction to the demo, product-side."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"His engineers were into it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Engineering reaction to the demo; observed."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"I don't know that anything got silence.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Dodges the silence question; conflicts with later pushback."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"I said something about growing revenue","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Rep's revenue framing, which the customer pushed back on."},
{"id":"E21","turn":16,"excerpt":"we're not trying to grow revenue with billing, we're trying to stop it being a tax on the roadmap.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Customer rejected the revenue framing directly."},
{"id":"E22","turn":18,"excerpt":"The freeze email.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's first sign the deal would not close."},
{"id":"E23","turn":18,"excerpt":"Before that we were in procurement.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Deal had reached procurement before the freeze."},
{"id":"E24","turn":20,"excerpt":"I can't get this past Diane without a number that's ours.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider"],"note":"Owen needed a customer-specific number to get past Diane."},
{"id":"E25","turn":20,"excerpt":"I sent him the ROI deck. The general one, with the study.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Generic ROI deck sent; not customer-specific."},
{"id":"E26","turn":20,"excerpt":"We were going to set up a session to build one.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer-specific ROI session planned but never held."},
{"id":"E27","turn":22,"excerpt":"About a month.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Gap between payback request and freeze."},
{"id":"E28","turn":24,"excerpt":"The number. Their own.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer wanted its own cost figure; not provided."},
{"id":"E29","turn":24,"excerpt":"we don't touch billing before renewal season.","label":"quote","speaker":"Unnamed engineering lead","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Migration timing constraint; a doc existed for it."},
{"id":"E30","turn":24,"excerpt":"We never added it up.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Cost of the homegrown system was never calculated."},
{"id":"E31","turn":24,"excerpt":"He also asked about migration.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Migration questions asked; rep's account of them."},
{"id":"E32","turn":24,"excerpt":"He wanted to talk to someone who'd done it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer wanted a reference contact; unclear if provided."},
{"id":"E33","turn":24,"excerpt":"some landlord subscriptions lapse because the card fails and nobody chases it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Revenue-leak pain the customer mentioned once; never quantified."},
{"id":"E34","turn":26,"excerpt":"a tax on the roadmap.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","message"],"note":"Owen's core problem phrase."},
{"id":"E35","turn":26,"excerpt":"if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded.","label":"quote","speaker":"Diane (CFO), relayed through Owen","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decider"],"note":"Diane's funding criterion, relayed secondhand."},
{"id":"E36","turn":26,"excerpt":"nice to have","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Owen's description of how finance saw the project."},
{"id":"E37","turn":28,"excerpt":"For Owen, yeah.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Rep says it was on fire for Owen only."},
{"id":"E38","turn":28,"excerpt":"I don't think anyone told her what it was costing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep's guess that Diane lacked the cost picture."},
{"id":"E39","turn":30,"excerpt":"It'll come back next year.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep expects the project to return; no evidence given."},
{"id":"E40","turn":30,"excerpt":"I don't think there was anything we could have done.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Conflicts with unanswered requests for ROI and migration help."},
{"id":"E41","turn":24,"excerpt":"We had a doc for that.","label":"fact","speaker":"Renee (rep)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our existing migration doc; against customer's renewal-timing constraint."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E9","E8"],"what":"Rep first says the freeze was not against us, then says Diane decided against everything."},
{"evidence":["E19","E21"],"what":"Rep says nothing got silence, but the revenue framing drew direct pushback from Owen."},
{"evidence":["E40","E30"],"what":"Rep says nothing could have been done, yet admits the cost was never added up and the ROI session never happened."},
{"evidence":["E6","E9"],"what":"Rep says the CFO froze everything (a general hold), then says she decided against everything, treating a general hold as a specific decision."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Who made the final call, and how do you know?","turn":5,"what":"Answered with a guess ('I guess?') and reframed the freeze as not against us."},
{"question":"What did the customer bring up about the competitor?","turn":11,"what":"Said 'There wasn't one' then hedged with 'as far as I know'."},
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":15,"what":"Said 'I don't know that anything got silence', then described pushback on the revenue framing."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":29,"what":"Answered 'It's timing' and moved to a judgment rather than new facts."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"a tax on the roadmap","ours":"growing revenue","evidence":["E20","E21","E34"]},
{"theirs":"something that shows payback?","ours":"ROI deck","evidence":["E14","E25"]},
{"theirs":"a number that's ours","ours":"The general one, with the study","evidence":["E24","E25"]},
{"theirs":"that's a quarter of roadmap in five minutes","ours":"Changing a price in a few clicks","evidence":["E17","E16"]},
{"theirs":"we don't touch billing before renewal season","ours":"We had a doc for that.","evidence":["E29","E41"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E6","E7"],"what":"Freeze on all new vendor projects after Q3 miss; rep reads it as a no-decision, not a loss to a competitor. Not partial."},
{"evidence":["E22","E23"],"what":"Deal had reached procurement and paper was sent before the freeze."},
{"evidence":["E39","E40"],"what":"Rep expects the project to return next year; this is opinion, not a confirmed next step."}
]}
